top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Fall on US Tech Jitters, Yuan Weakens: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks fell after a selloff in US chipmakers deepened, overshadowing a plunge in oil prices amid optimism over diplomatic progress toward ending the war in Iran. The yuan weakened.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Binance begins second withdrawal phase, exchange outflows slow
top_signals.summary: The exchange says additional assets will become available for withdrawal from 04:00 UTC on Tuesday as security checks are completed, following an initial reopening on Nov. 1.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
